claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Levocetirizine is a peripherally restricted H1 antihistamine with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, with any weak antiproliferative signal reflecting non-specific physicochemical effects rather than a defined killing mechanism.
